nodes.label: Routed reference setup
nodes.statement: On one fixed trial history and probe interval, delta=Delta+l_F-l_A; beta updates by beta_next=(1-eta)beta+eta*d with 0<eta<1; q=delta-a*beta; R=1[q-b*beta+epsilon_R>0]; U=q/s+epsilon_U with s>0 and the specified independent consumer port. Compare S=(a,b)=(1,0) and C=(0,1) under identical inputs, registers and conditional noise laws; actual routing differs. Computation follows both arrivals.
